options.text: A substance made of only one type of atom
Two or more elements chemically bonded together in fixed proportions
Two or more substances that are not chemically bonded
A substance that can be separated by filtration

questions.explanation: A compound is a pure substance made from two or more different elements chemically bonded together in fixed proportions. For example, water (H2O) is a compound of hydrogen and oxygen.

questions.stem: How can a mixture be separated into its components?

options.text: Only by heating to very high temperatures
By physical methods such as filtration or distillation
Mixtures cannot be separated once formed

questions.explanation: Mixtures can be separated by physical methods such as filtration, distillation, and evaporation because the substances in a mixture are not chemically bonded together. Compounds, by contrast, require chemical reactions to separate.
